decisions.reason: The MOOG 81234 front spring set has no enforceable trim, suspension, transmission, or year scope across 2006-2011, and the current catalog pass did not confirm full application coverage.
Walker 235-1456 is an older Hyundai/Kia sensor application and the current catalog pass did not confirm it for the 2021-2023 Rio 1.6L scope; the existing two retailer links must be held.
The issue prescribes a complete interference-engine timing service, while Gates T41031 is only a tensioner and the current catalog did not confirm its complete 2001-2005 application.

The P0303 article is diagnosis-dependent and spans three distinct engines, while the unscoped Champion 9047 plug card cannot be assumed to fit every engine or repair the most-common failed-coil branch.
The Beck/Arnley 178-8281 coil is applied across a ten-year unscoped article with changing engine/ignition applications, and the current catalog pass did not prove full coverage.
DENSO 477-0853 is attached to a build-date-sensitive TSB article spanning three engines and six model years without enforceable build or HVAC qualifiers; current catalog evidence did not confirm it.
